data.name: Whiskey Premium
data.description: A smooth and rich premium whiskey aged for 12 years. Perfect for sipping neat or on the rocks with notes of vanilla, oak, and caramel.

data.name: Vodka Crystal
data.description: Ultra-pure vodka distilled five times for exceptional smoothness. Ideal for cocktails or enjoying straight with a crisp, clean finish.

data.name: Tequila Sunrise
data.description: Premium tequila made from 100% blue agave. Smooth, slightly sweet taste with hints of citrus and pepper. Perfect for margaritas.

data.name: Red Wine Reserve
data.description: Full-bodied red wine with complex flavors of dark berries, plum, and subtle spices. Aged in oak barrels for 18 months.

data.name: Gin Botanical
data.description: Artisanal gin infused with 12 botanicals including juniper, coriander, and citrus peel. Perfect for a classic gin and tonic.

data.name: Rum Caribbean Gold
data.description: Golden rum with rich flavors of tropical fruits, vanilla, and molasses. Aged for 8 years in charred oak barrels.

data.name: Champagne Brut
data.description: Elegant champagne with fine bubbles and flavors of green apple, white peach, and brioche. Perfect for celebrations.

data.name: Cognac XO
data.description: Extra Old cognac aged for 15 years. Rich and complex with notes of dried fruits, spices, and oak. A true luxury spirit.

data.name: Sake Premium
data.description: Traditional Japanese sake with a delicate, refined flavor profile. Clean and smooth with hints of melon and rice.

data.name: Bourbon Oak Barrel
data.description: Small batch bourbon with bold flavors of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak. Smooth finish with a hint of spice.
